pluss::subsp::stats::ts::SsmModel¶

The matrices and initial moments of a linear Gaussian state-space model.

SsmModel describes x_{t+1} = A x_t + B w_t, y_t = C x_t + D v_t for m state variables, n observed series, k state shocks and h observation shocks.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

transition

pluss::Series

—

A, m × m: how the state evolves.

state_loading

pluss::Series

—

B, m × k: how the state shocks enter; its columns are standard deviations, so the state noise covariance is B B'.

observation

pluss::Series

—

C, n × m: how the state shows in the observations.

innovation_loading

pluss::Series

—

D, n × h: observation noise; covariance D D'.

mean0

pluss::Series

—

Mean of the state before the first observation (a vector of length m).

cov0

pluss::Series

—

Covariance of that state, m × m; make it large to express ignorance of the starting level.

Guidance¶

Because the initial moments describe the state one step before the first observation, the first forecast of the state is A mean0 with covariance A cov0 A' + B B'.
